alerts.soReadyToShip: {{ count }} Sales Orders ready to ship
alerts.toPastDue: {{ count }} Transfer Order past due date

ai.availabilityDesc: Before confirming a sales order line, AI verifies live stock and warns if inventory may fall short.
ai.reorderDesc: AI analyses sales velocity and lead times to recommend exactly what to buy and when.
ai.routingDesc: AI picks the best source warehouse for each transfer based on current stock and distance.
ai.countDesc: AI ranks which items to count first by flagging high-risk discrepancies before they become losses.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in with your Grow Path account.
login.updateAvailable: A newer version of the app is available. Update when you can.
login.genericError: Could not sign you in. Please try again.

mfa.title: Enter your code
mfa.subtitle: Open your authenticator app and enter the six-digit code. You can use one of your recovery codes instead.
mfa.codeError: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
mfa.rejected: That code was not accepted. Try again.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the address you sign in with and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.sentMessage: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. The link is valid for one hour.
forgotPassword.sentHint: Already have the link? Open it, or paste the token on the reset screen.
forgotPassword.genericError: Could not send the link. Please try again.

resetPassword.doneMessage: Your password is set. You have been signed out everywhere else — sign in again to continue.
resetPassword.title: New password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a password of at least {{ count }} characters. Setting it signs you out on every other device.
resetPassword.tokenHint: Filled in automatically when you open the link from your email.
resetPassword.tokenError: Paste the token from your reset email.
resetPassword.genericError: That reset link is no longer valid. Request a new one.

acceptInvitation.doneMessage: {{ email }} is ready. Sign in with the password you just chose.
acceptInvitation.title: Accept your invitation
acceptInvitation.subtitle: Choose a password of at least {{ count }} characters to finish setting up your account.
acceptInvitation.tokenHint: Filled in automatically when you open the link from your invitation.
acceptInvitation.tokenError: Paste the token from your invitation.
acceptInvitation.genericError: That invitation is no longer valid. Ask your administrator for a new one.

setupRequired.title: Setup needed
setupRequired.notice: You are signed in correctly — this is not a problem with your account. Your workspace is not connected to Dynamics 365 yet.
setupRequired.footer: Ask your administrator to finish setup in the admin portal.

environment.title: Record the environment
environment.body: Your operator adds the Dynamics instance your organisation runs on.

credentials.title: Connect the credentials
credentials.body: The connection is tested against Dynamics and saved only if it passes.

company.title: Add a company
company.body: At least one legal entity, so orders and stock know which company they belong to.

erp.noEnvironmentDetail: Your workspace has not been connected to Dynamics 365. An administrator needs to add an environment in the admin portal before any data can load.
erp.notConfiguredDetail: Your Dynamics environment exists but has no sign-in details saved. An administrator needs to add the client ID and secret in the admin portal, then run the connection test.
erp.failingDetail: Dynamics rejected the saved sign-in details — usually an expired secret. An administrator needs to update them in the admin portal.
erp.noCompanyDetail: Your Dynamics environment is connected, but no company has been added to it yet. An administrator needs to add one in the admin portal.

error.offline: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
error.throttledSeconds: Too many attempts. Try again in {{ seconds }} seconds.
error.badRequest: That request was not valid. Check the details and try again.
error.unauthorized: Those sign-in details are not correct.
error.forbidden: You do not have access to that.
error.conflict: That conflicts with something that already exists.
error.server: The server had a problem. Please try again shortly.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

d365.connectionNotConfigured: The ERP connection is not set up yet. Ask your administrator to finish it in the admin portal.
d365.companyRequired: This account covers more than one company. Choose one and try again.
d365.unauthorized: The server could not sign in to the ERP. Ask your administrator to check the connection.
d365.timeout: The ERP took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.
d365.unreachable: The ERP could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
